title: Contents Packout & Storage Customer Payments, Card Surcharge and Refunds
content:
Payments, card surcharges and refunds on a Contents Packout & Storage job follow these rules.

## Rule

1. The job must not be closed when a customer payment is posted.
2. Customer payments are accepted by credit card, debit card, ACH or check and are posted in full to the one job they name.
3. A credit card payment carries a surcharge of the credit card surcharge percentage of the payment amount, booked as its own line and rounded to the cent, half up, and no other tender is surcharged.
4. A refund is issued only while the job's balance due is negative, for the credit balance but never more than the customer payment it is returned from, to that payment's original tender, within the refund processing business days.
5. A credit balance created by insurance proceeds is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy.

## Tender table

| Tender | Accepted | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| credit card | yes | the tier's credit card surcharge percentage of the payment amount, as its own line, rounded to the cent, half up |
| debit card | yes | none |
| ACH | yes | none |
| check | yes | none |

The surcharge percentage and the refund processing business days are the tier values on the product's desk reference of payment and credit figures.

## Refunds

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| balance due negative, credit balance from customer payments | refund of the credit balance, never more than the customer payment it is returned from, to that payment's original tender, within the refund processing business days |
| balance due zero or positive | no refund |
| credit balance created by insurance proceeds | handed to a human representative as not covered by policy |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- At a hypothetical surcharge of 2.5 percent, a credit card payment of 410.00 carries a surcharge line of 10.25; a debit card payment of the same amount carries none.
- A job showing a balance of minus 80.00 after a customer check of 50.00 and a card payment of 300.00 may refund at most 50.00 from the check (to the check's tender) or the 80.00 credit balance from the card payment (to the card).
